reference.name: Organization Follow button label splits across lines at mobile width
reference.summary: Below 768px on an organization’s profile, the Follow button is squeezed beside the organization name and its label breaks mid-word (“Fol”/“low”; “Unfollow” across three lines).
reference.expected: At phone width the Follow/Unfollow button keeps its label on one line, or the header wraps so the button has room.
reference.actual: At 390px on an organization page reached from Site Administration > Organizations, the Follow button shrank to about 62×46px and rendered “Fol” and “low” on two lines; after following, “Unfollow” split into “Unf”/“ollo”/“w”. Widths of 768px and up, and a one-letter display name, rendered on one line.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and set the viewport to 390×844.
Open Site Administration > Organizations and open an organization with a typical-length display name.
Look at the Follow button next to the organization name and observe its label split mid-word across lines.
